problem: A broker has submitted a warehouse for property cover with a declared value of $4,250,000.

answers.common.decision: Whether to accept, price or decline the risk; the underwriter decides.

answers.common.materials: Sprinklers cover 60% of the floor area. Our guidelines refer any warehouse valued over $5,000,000, or without full sprinkler cover, to a senior underwriter. The insured had two water damage claims totalling $85,000 in the last five years.
answers.insurance.file: Commercial property submission for a warehouse, our standard property wording.
answers.insurance.decider: The underwriter decides; a senior underwriter decides any referred risk.
